node.title: XR deficient active-defect family: mixed core/block payment
node.statement: For an affine dimension-s active-defect-local deficient family, double counting (s-1) independent punctured-core hyperplanes with two points in one selected defect block gives |Tau| <= (n-e)_(s-1)e(e-1)/(r(r-ell) product_{j=2}^s(d+ell+j)) whenever ell<r. The line residual has at most two members per witness; a degenerate determinant forces a constant selected slope and is removed by same-ray interaction. Combined with the affine-span compiler, exact official arithmetic pays dimensions 10,10,9 at rates 1/4,1/8,1/16. Any SL2-D counterexample has dimension at least 11,11,10.
